name: assess-constitutionality
description: Assesses whether a Cardano governance action complies with the Constitution: a live on-chain action, a signed or unsigned transaction before submission, or a draft. Produces a provision-by-provision findings report against the mirrored constitutional text. Triggers: "is this governance action constitutional", "assess constitutionality", "constitutional review", "check this proposal against the Constitution", "will this treasury withdrawal pass CC review", "review my governance action draft", "check my governance action before I submit", "check this unsigned transaction", "constitutional defects".
